override_minigrid_defaults: set default encoder, hidden size, and observation scaling params for a MiniGrid environment parser
review_minigrid_override_defaults: review the minigrid_override_defaults function to understand which MiniGrid RL training hyperparameters it configures
refactor_minigrid_override_defaults: refactor minigrid_override_defaults to add or remove default hyperparameters for the MiniGrid encoder and observation scaling
test_minigrid_override_defaults: test that minigrid_override_defaults correctly sets encoder_subtype, hidden_size, and obs_scale on the parser
summarize_minigrid_override_defaults: summarize the minigrid_override_defaults function and list all default hyperparameters it applies to the MiniGrid environment
